description: This file defines an Android activity class 'CalendarWatchFacePermissionActivity' that handles requesting and managing user permissions for reading the calendar within a wearable device context.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFacePermissionActivity
classes.description: An activity that requests calendar read permission from the user and handles the permission result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and enables ambient mode.

methods.name: onClickEnablePermission
methods.description: Triggered when the user presses a button to enable calendar permission; it requests the READ_CALENDAR permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Callback handling the user's response to the permission request; finishes the activity if permission is granted.
